content.text:
I'm going with **עוקב מדד S&P 500**, fund number 13414. Fairly sure.

What decided it: it's the S&P that everyone at work talks about. It's also the only row near the top with real numbers in the return column: "13.7%" over 3 years and "11.92%" over 5. Most of the other rows just say "פחות מ־3 שנים" (less than 3 years). And it's huge, "2.3 מיליארד ₪". The fee is "0.56%" and "0%" on deposits, which is basically what every other track costs. So the fee doesn't help me choose, and it's not a reason to avoid it either.

**How it went**
- **Screen 1:** The big heading "הראל" (Harel) and the "קופת גמל להשקעה 16" tab was already selected, so I was in the right place. The line "16 מסלולים · דמי ניהול מ־0.54% עד 0.61%" (16 tracks, fees from 0.54% to 0.61%) told me the fees are all about the same. The first rows were "אשראי ואג"ח" and "מניות סחיר". Credit and bonds don't mean much to me, and both rows said "פחות מ־3 שנים" anyway.
- **Screen 2:** I stopped at "עוקב מדד S&P 500" because I know that name. It has the big green-ish ring, "99%" stocks and "99%" מט"ח (foreign currency). I glanced at the rest: "עוקב מדדי מניות" (stock indexes) has no returns, "כספי (שקלי)" (cash, shekels) shows 4.25%, and "קיימות" (sustainability) shows 1.78%. S&P is clearly ahead.
- **Screen 3:** Skimmed. There was a grey note under the table and a list of folds under "מה כתוב במסמכים של הראל" (what's in Harel's documents). I didn't open any of them.
- **Screen 4:** A search box and a footer. I skipped both.

**Where I hesitated**
- "פחות מ־3 שנים / פחות מ־5 שנים" (less than 3 / 5 years) on almost every row. I guess it means those tracks are too new to show a return, but I'm not sure. It made most of the table useless to me.
- A row near the bottom of screen 1, "כללי", seemed to show 13.5%, but it was cut off. "כללי" just means "general". It sounded vague, so I didn't go back to it.
- Between screen 2 and screen 3 there's a jump. I never saw rows like "הלכה יהודית" (Jewish law) in full.
- I don't know what the rings mean, and I didn't look for a legend. I guessed teal is stocks and yellow is foreign currency, going by the dots.

**What I'd change**
- Get rid of the wall of "פחות מ־X שנים" or explain it in a single line.
- Show the fee in shekels, like "on 30,000 that's about X ₪ a year". 0.56% means nothing to me.
- Say on the first screen which track is the plain index one.
- Tell me what to actually do first. Nothing on the page says how to open the fund, and the "מה זה קופת גמל להשקעה" link (what is an investment savings fund) is small.
